_comment: Expansion 3 part E.6: spells outside battle - lasting protections and the caster's keeping (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md). Numbers from the 2024 Player's Handbook. Done in game/warding.py (road ops 'protect' with its 'how', 'hallow', 'demiplane', 'cauldron'; kinds in rules/spells.E6_KINDS, checked at start-up).

glyph_of_warding.name: Glyph of Warding

material.text: powdered diamond worth 200+ GP, which the spell consumes

glyph_of_warding.text: A glyph on the way into the camp waits for whatever comes in the night: an explosive rune (5d8, a Dexterity save for half) or a stored spell of level 5 or lower that strikes the first of them as the fight begins. Either way you are awake. In a town it guards your room at the inn.

symbol.name: Symbol

material.text: powdered diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

symbol.text: A harmful glyph on the way into the camp: whatever comes in the night meets Death (10d10 necrotic), Discord, Fear, Pain, Sleep or Stunning before it reaches you.

guards_and_wards.name: Guards and Wards
guards_and_wards.text: For a day, fog, locked ways and webs ward the camp: what comes in the night loses its way half the time, and a magic mouth wakes you when it does not. Underground, hunters lose the way to you: you may rest.

forbiddance.name: Forbiddance
forbiddance.text: For a day, aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead that come into the camp take 5d10 radiant or necrotic damage, and again at the end of each of their turns in a fight there.

magic_circle.name: Magic Circle

material.text: salt and powdered silver worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes

magic_circle.text: For an hour (one more for each slot above 3), celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead cannot come into the camp, and strike at those inside with Disadvantage. Underground you may rest while only such things hunt you.

mordenkainens_private_sanctum.name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
mordenkainens_private_sanctum.text: For a day the camp is dark fog and silence to anyone outside: the night is half as likely to bring anything as a cold camp's, even with a fire, and nobody finds the animals.

hallow.name: Hallow

material.text: incense worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

hallow.text: A day of prayer makes the ground holy for good: aberrations, elementals, fey, fiends and undead cannot come onto it, and one more blessing holds there (Courage, Fear, Resistance, Vulnerability or Peaceful Rest: a haunted field's dead never rise again).

demiplane.name: Demiplane
demiplane.text: A shadowy door to a stone room out of the world: leave your coin, treasure or spare arms there for good, or take them back; for the hour the door stands it is a room to rest in, whatever hunts outside.

tashas_bubbling_cauldron.name: Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron
tashas_bubbling_cauldron.text: A claw-footed cauldron brews potions of one common or uncommon kind, as many as your spellcasting modifier. They keep until you cast it again, when the last of them vanish; no merchant will buy them.
